caps.text:
some boring things that actually fixed my sleep (no melatonin)
😴🛏️

my phone charges in the kitchen

my bed stopped being a cinema

same bedtime every night, even fridays

your body loves boring

lamps only after 10

ceiling lights tell your brain it's noon

my apps go to sleep at 11 (i use locturne)

no willpower needed at 1am

what's the weirdest thing that helps you sleep?
